pages.title: Yash Rana — Software Developer & AI / ML Portfolio
pages.description: Portfolio of Yash Rana — Applied ML and generative AI developer, Concordia graduate, and Technical Specialist at GEXEL in Montréal. Explore multimodal RAG, NLP, and full-stack engineering.

pages.title: About | Yash Rana
pages.description: Background, education, and technical skills of Yash Rana, a Concordia Master of Applied Computer Science graduate.

pages.title: Experience | Yash Rana
pages.description: Data science, analytics, and full-stack development experience at GEXEL Telecom International, Blue Data Consulting, The Sparks Foundation, and DevTown.

pages.title: Redline Markets
pages.description: F1 prediction market platform with Polymarket-style trading cards, GP Coins economy, Stripe checkout, Firebase Auth, and a Spring Boot REST + WebSocket backend for real-time trades and chat.

pages.title: F1 Vision
pages.description: Full-stack F1 race intelligence platform with live telemetry ingestion, Gradient Boosting race predictions, driver/team analytics, and LLM-generated strategy insights.

pages.title: Chess Application & Engine
pages.description: Playable C++17 chess engine with an SDL2 interface, legal move generation, castling, en passant, and promotion. Its threaded AI combines iterative deepening, alpha-beta pruning, quiescence search, transposition caching, and move ordering.

pages.title: F1 Prediction Market
pages.description: Real-time F1 prediction market with live data feeds, ML-driven odds, and user predictions on race outcomes and championship standings.

pages.title: Early Diabetes Detection
pages.description: Published ICAAAI 2025 (Atlantis Press). SVM-based diagnostic model achieving 95% accuracy for early-stage diabetes prediction, benchmarked via ROC-AUC against Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and KNN.

pages.title: Distributed Share Market
pages.description: Fault-tolerant replicated trading system with active replication, consensus protocols, and autonomous recovery for high availability under crash and Byzantine failures.

pages.title: Online Movie Ticket Booking
pages.description: Full-stack booking platform with authentication, real-time seat selection, simulated secure payments, and role-based access for admin and customer flows.

pages.title: Sales GPT
pages.description: AI sales assistant automating lead qualification, personalized outreach, and real-time conversation coaching via LLMs.

pages.title: BERT Sentiment Analysis
pages.description: Fine-tuned BERT for sentiment classification served via Flask REST API, with full training pipeline and inference endpoint.

pages.title: Book Recommendation System
pages.description: Collaborative filtering + content-based recommendation engine trained on reading history and user preferences.

pages.title: Style Fusion
pages.description: Neural style transfer blending artistic styles with content images using VGG feature extraction and content/style loss optimization.

pages.title: Abstractive Text Summarization
pages.description: Modular transformer-based summarization for long, unstructured documents, with separate ingestion, preprocessing, model inference, and evaluation stages for reproducible runs.

pages.title: Task Tracker CLI
pages.description: Java command-line task manager with task creation, updates, deletion, status transitions, and filtering. Tasks persist in a JSON file with timestamps, with validation for invalid commands and missing inputs.

pages.title: Unit Converter
pages.description: Full-stack converter for length, weight, and temperature, with a React interface, light/dark themes, and a Spring Boot JSON REST API using enum-based conversions and temperature formulas.

pages.title: Video Scene Intelligence
pages.description: Ask natural-language questions about video and get answers with timestamped citations. Combines Whisper transcripts, Gemini frame captions, and Qdrant semantic retrieval in an asynchronous, full-stack RAG pipeline.

pages.title: Personal Wealth Intelligence Dashboard
pages.description: Portfolio dashboard bringing asset management, allocation charts, net-worth history, risk concentration, and CSV imports into one interface, with authentication and encrypted storage for sensitive asset data.

pages.title: Financial Fraud Detection
pages.description: Explores fraud detection on highly imbalanced transaction data using cleaning, feature engineering, multicollinearity analysis, and Decision Tree / Random Forest classifiers. Evaluates precision, recall, and F1 alongside accuracy.

pages.title: Number Guessing Game
pages.description: Spring Boot CLI game with difficulty levels, limited attempts, higher/lower hints, timed rounds, and saved high scores for each difficulty.

pages.title: YouTube Clone
pages.description: Web application exploring a YouTube-style experience using the Play Framework and Akka. Part of the earlier web engineering collection.
